verses.en: Hear this word, ye kine of Bashan, that are in the mountain of Samaria, which oppress the poor, which crush the needy, which say to their masters, Bring, and let us drink.
verses.pt: Ouvi esta palavra, vós vacas de Basã, que estais no monte de Samaria; que oprimis os pobres, que quebrantais os necessitados, que dizeis a seus senhores: Trazei nossa bebida.
verses.en_web: Listen to this word, you cows of Bashan, who are on the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy, who tell their husbands, “Bring us drinks!”
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to this word, you cows of Bashan, who are in the hill of Samaria, by whom the poor are kept down, and those in need are crushed; who say to their lords, Get out the wine and give us drink.

verses.en: The Lord GOD hath sworn by his holiness, that, lo, the days shall come upon you, that he will take you away with hooks, and your posterity with fishhooks.
verses.pt: O Senhor DEUS jurou por sua santidade: Eis que vêm dias sobre vós em que vos levarão em ganchos, e a vossos descendentes em anzóis de pesca.
verses.en_web: The Lord Yahweh has sworn by his holiness that behold, “The days shall come on you that they will take you away with hooks, and the last of you with fish hooks.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord God has taken an oath by his holy name, that the days are coming when they will take you away with hooks, and the rest of you with fish-hooks.

verses.en: And ye shall go out at the breaches, every cow at that which is before her; and ye shall cast them into the palace, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: E saireis pelas brechas cada uma atrás da outra, e sereis lançadas para Harmom, diz o SENHOR.
verses.en_web: You will go out at the breaks in the wall, everyone straight before her; and you will cast yourselves into Harmon,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And you will go out through the broken places, every one going straight before her, and you will be sent into Harmon, says the Lord.

verses.en: Come to Bethel, and transgress; at Gilgal multiply transgression; and bring your sacrifices every morning, and your tithes after three years:
verses.pt: Ide a Betel, e transgredi; em Gilgal aumentai as transgressões, e de manhã trazei vossos sacrifícios, vossos dízimos ao terceiro dia.
verses.en_web: “Go to Bethel, and sin; to Gilgal, and sin more. Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three days,
verses.en_bbe: Come to Beth-el and do evil; to Gilgal, increasing the number of your sins; come with your offerings every morning and your tenths every three days:

verses.en: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, and proclaim and publish the free offerings: for this liketh you, O ye children of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.pt: E oferecei sacrifício de louvores com lêvedo, e anunciai ofertas voluntárias; pois é assim que quereis, ó filhos de Israel,diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.en_web: offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving of that which is leavened, and proclaim free will offerings and brag about them: for this pleases you, you children of Israel,” says the Lord Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Let that which is leavened be burned as a praise-offering, let the news of your free offerings be given out publicly; for this is pleasing to you, O children of Israel, says the Lord.

verses.en: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Eu também vos dei bocas vazias em todas vossas cidades, e falta de pão em todos os vossos lugares, contudo não vos convertestes a mim,diz o SENHOR.
verses.en_web: “I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and lack of bread in every town; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: But in all your towns I have kept food from your teeth, and in all your places there has been need of bread: and still you have not come back to me, says the Lord.

verses.en: And also I have withholden the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest: and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.
verses.pt: Além disso eu vos retive a chuva três meses antes da colheita; e fiz chover sobre uma cidade, e sobre outra cidade não fiz chover; sobre um campo choveu; mas o outro campo sobre o qual não choveu, se secou;
verses.en_web: “I also have withheld the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest; and I caused it to rain on one city, and caused it not to rain on another city. One place was rained on, and the piece where it didn’t rain withered.
verses.en_bbe: And I have kept back the rain from you, when it was still three months before the grain-cutting: I sent rain on one town and kept it back from another: one part was rained on, and the part where there was no rain became a waste.

verses.en: So two or three cities wandered unto one city, to drink water; but they were not satisfied: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: De modo que os moradores de duas ou três cidades perambulavam até uma cidade para beberem água, mas não se saciavam; contudo não vos convertestes a mim,diz o SENHOR.
verses.en_web: So two or three cities staggered to one city to drink water, and were not satisfied: yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: So two or three towns went wandering to one town looking for water, and did not get enough: and still you have not come back to me, says the Lord.

verses.en: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew: when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased, the palmerworm devoured them: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Eu vos feri com ferrugem e doenças nas plantas; a multidão de vossos jardins e vossas vinhas, vossas figueiras e vossas oliveiras o gafanhoto comeu; contudo não vos convertestes a mim,diz o SENHOR.
verses.en_web: “I struck you with blight and mildew many times in your gardens and your vineyards; and your fig trees and your olive trees have the swarming locust devoured: yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: I have sent destruction on your fields by burning and disease: the increase of your gardens and your vine-gardens, your fig-trees and your olive-trees, has been food for worms: and still you have not come back to me, says the Lord.

verses.en: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: your young men have I slain with the sword, and have taken away your horses; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Enviei entre vós a pestilência, à maneira do Egito; matei à espada vossos rapazes, e deixei que capturassem vossos cavalos; e fiz subir o mau cheiro de vossos exércitos até vossas narinas; contudo não vos convertestes a mim,diz o SENHOR.
verses.en_web: “I sent plagues among you like I did Egypt. I have slain your young men with the sword, and have carried away your horses; and I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camp, yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: I have sent disease among you, as it was in Egypt: I have put your young men to the sword, and have taken away your horses; I have made the evil smell from your tents come up to your noses: and still you have not come back to me, says the Lord.

verses.en: I have overthrown some of you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Transtornei a alguns dentre vós, como quando Deus transtornou a Sodoma e a Gomorra, e fostes como tição escapado do fogo; contudo não vos convertestes a mim, diz o SENHOR.
verses.en_web: “I have overthrown some of you, as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a burning stick plucked out of the fire; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And I have sent destruction among you, as when God sent destruction on Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a burning stick pulled out of the fire: and still you have not come back to me, says the Lord.

verses.en: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: and because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.
verses.pt: Portanto assim farei a ti, ó Israel; e visto que te farei isto, ó Israel, prepara-te para te encontrares com teu Deus.
verses.en_web: “Therefore thus will I do to you, Israel; because I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, Israel.
verses.en_bbe: So this is what I will do to you, O Israel: and because I will do this to you, be ready for a meeting with your God, O Israel.

verses.en: For, lo, he that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth unto man what is his thought, that maketh the morning darkness, and treadeth upon the high places of the earth, The LORD, The God of hosts, is his name.
verses.pt: Porque eis que ele é que forma os montes, cria o vento, e informa seu pensamento ao ser humano; ele é o que torna a manhã em trevas, e pisa sobre as alturas da terra; EU-SOU, o Deus dos exércitos, é o seu nome.
verses.en_web: For, behold, he who forms the mountains, and creates the wind, and declares to man what is his thought; who makes the morning darkness, and treads on the high places of the earth: Yahweh, the God of Armies, is his name.”
verses.en_bbe: For see, he who gave form to the mountains and made the wind, giving knowledge of his purpose to man, who makes the morning dark, and is walking on the high places of the earth: the Lord, the God of armies, is his name.
